results.reader_title: Stock-option taxation and European startup finance
results.reader_what: Henrekson and Sanandaji argue that European employee stock-option tax rules impede startup financing and growth compared with the United States.
results.reader_why: Links European entrepreneurial innovation capacity to employee equity and VC incentives.
results.reader_more: Henrekson and Sanandaji argue that European employee stock-option tax rules impede startup financing and growth compared with the United States. The source basis is peer-reviewed comparative institutional/tax analysis published in 2018. Tax-treatment explanation is an argument about incentives; the article does not establish a uniform causal effect across all European countries.
